indexing_estimate: ~30M documents, ~1.2B tokens total, expected embedding store ~1.1TB (dense vectors 768d, float16 compressed)
throughput_target: sustained 120 QPS during peak windows, burst to 250 QPS
cost_per_query_target: target average cost < $0.002 per query (vector search + rerank amortized)
preferred_models: option to fallback to smaller emb models for cold traffic
reranking_strategy: Two-stage pipeline: ANN dense retrieval (HNSW, sharded) -> top-50 candidate cross-encoder rerank. Explore distilled cross-encoder to lower latency/cost, with automatic fallback to heuristics under load.
storage_and_indexing_tech: Prefer vector indexes that support sharding + incremental updates (FAISS-IVF/HNSW hybrid). Long-term archive to S3 (EU) with warm-hot caching layer for most-accessed docs.
recent_poc_findings: Cross-encoder rerank is the dominant cost; quantized 16->8-bit experiments reduced latency 30% but raised small quality delta. Batching and continuous KV caching reduces per-query compute by ~18% in sim tests.
procurement_notes: Requested 3-year reserved Dedicated pool options, month-to-month burst, and ability to pin model versions. Legal needs KMS HSM attestation and data-residency clause for EU/UK. Finance asked for line-item TCO projection.
